protocol.uncertainty: Paired out-of-sample workload and efficiency residual replay, individually centered and frozen before a whole test week; counts rounded, receptions bounded by simulated targets. Zero workloads do not define efficiency: their rate residual is zero.
protocol.referenceCutoffs: Brier comparisons use pregame baseline-mean-derived half-lines, not historical sportsbook lines or prices.
protocol.qbAblation: Refit workload and efficiency models without explicit earlier observed QB continuity/passing-efficiency signals, holding selected ridge settings fixed. Actual game passing-leader changes are outcome-only slices, never forecast inputs. Associations are not causal effects.
protocol.limits: Retrospective source vintage; conditional on a recorded same-team appearance. Missing appearances remain unresolved. Unverified probabilities; no automatic promotion, obtainable-return claim or superiority to AI.
